comment: Declares pack-vs-project file ownership for scripts/sync_from_pack.py. framework_owned: the pack is the source of truth; sync updates these (with local-modification conflict detection via .devteam/sync_state.json). project_owned: the project's own state; sync NEVER touches these. merge_special: files that are part-pack part-project, handled by dedicated merge logic, never whole-file overwritten.
project_owned: .devteam/ (including derived atlas.db and any atlas cache; rebuildable, never merged)

### Builder territory mapping for THIS project
CLAUDE.md.comment: Everything above the project's marker is its own (name, stack, conventions) and is preserved; the pack's content refreshes the section BELOW that heading line; anything from a preserve_after sentinel onward is the project's own again and is preserved. TWO markers because onboarding produces two legal shapes (onboard.md STEP 4): a project with NO CLAUDE.md gets the pack's file verbatim (H1 marker); a project WITH one gets the section appended under the H2 marker -- the common case, which the single-marker version could never sync (found live on oikonomos 2026-08-15). preserve_after exists because STEP 4 also appends the project's REAL territory map AFTER the pack section; without it, the first successful sync would silently delete that map. Verified against both real shapes -- see docs/SYNC.md 'Verifying merge_special markers'.

autopilot.json.comment: New top-level keys and new nested keys from the pack template are ADDED; every existing value in the project's copy is preserved (the project's tuning -- interval, builders, control.mode, allowlists -- is its own).

.claude/settings.json.comment: Hook wiring is the most sensitive file (may contain the project's own non-DEVDEPARTMENT hooks). Sync only REPORTS if the pack's hooks.json declares hooks missing from it; a human or onboarding session applies the change.

.codex/config.toml.comment: Same posture: report drift, never auto-edit.
